_comment: Hook false-positive exceptions and audit-check exemptions. Each entry: {id, hook, pattern, reason, addedAt, addedBy, expiresAt, reviewNote, adr?}. Use hook='audit/<check>' for anti-pattern/cnt-health exemptions, 'lint/<rule>' for a scoped lint waiver. An exemption without expiresAt is a bypass, not a waiver (repository-discipline.md §9) — scripts/gs-cascade-check.mjs enforces it.

exceptions.reason: Chronicle dashboard is a local-only service. The localhost URLs are (a) the startup-message log telling the user where to navigate and (b) the API base URL in the embedded frontend template — both correct for a local dashboard.
exceptions.reviewNote: Permanent by design, reviewed annually: a local-only dashboard must print the URL the user navigates to. Re-confirm at the next review or convert to an ADR.

exceptions.reason: Dashboard server: HTTP routing + embedded HTML template + chart bootstrap. 488 lines. Refactor candidate — extract HTML template to a separate file in a follow-up.
exceptions.reviewNote: Expires when the embedded HTML template is extracted from src/dashboard/server.ts.

exceptions.reason: MCP server: tool registrations + handlers in one file. 509 lines. Cohesive surface — splitting would scatter the MCP tool definitions.
exceptions.reviewNote: Cohesion, not debt: the three MCP tool registrations belong together (ADR-011). Annual re-confirmation.

exceptions.reason: Coordination service: work-package decomposition + priority ranking + assignment. 771 lines. STRONG REFACTOR CANDIDATE — extract priority-ranking and assignment into separate modules in a follow-up.
exceptions.reviewNote: Expires with RM-401, which splits the service at the four seams named in EDR-004. Blocked on RM-103 (tests first).

exceptions.reason: Sync service: cloud<->local sync logic + conflict resolution. 523 lines. Refactor candidate — extract per-table sync handlers in a follow-up.
exceptions.reviewNote: Expires when per-table sync handlers are extracted. Blocked on RM-102 (tests first).

exceptions.reason: 5 lines (limit 3). Includes ForgeCraft sentinel comment + description.
exceptions.reviewNote: Permanent by design: the CNT root is 3 lines plus the sentinel comment (ADR-000). Annual re-confirmation.

exceptions.reason: 52 lines (limit 50). 2 lines over for chronicle's tier-memory model description, which is core to navigating the codebase.
exceptions.reviewNote: Permanent by design: core.md is the always-loaded identity node. Now 38 lines, within the 50-line bound — candidate for removal at the next review.

exceptions.reason: Chronicle-specific standards: 180 lines. Tier-memory model + sync semantics + dashboard contracts are interlinked — splitting would scatter the knowledge.
exceptions.reviewNote: Expires when chronicle-specific standards are split by concern (tier model / sync semantics / dashboard contracts).

exceptions.reason: 33 `as any[]` casts on SQL row results in the only two units with zero tests (522 and 771 lines). The rule is correct and protocols.md forbids `any` casts; the waiver exists because retyping uncovered code before characterising it is the wrong order. Typed row interfaces land with the tests in RM-102 and RM-103. Scoped in eslint.config.js to these two paths, so `any` anywhere else still fails the build.
exceptions.reviewNote: Expires with RM-102 and RM-103. Downgrade is warn, not off, so the count stays visible.
